explanation: Qwen2.5-0.5B L7/N4085+ responds to the noun that names a counted or named division of a larger ordered whole - a slot/position inside a document, series, table, building, administrative geography or time axis (chapter, page, paragraph, stanza, verse, section, line, column, row, layer, season, episode, act, round, floor, street, province, district, quarter, year, Friday) - and, when an index identifies the slot, to the index token that completes the phrase too ('In chapter seven' peaks 1.94 on ' seven'; 'the third page of the book' peaks 3.07 on ' of'; 'season one' peaks 3.00 on ' one'). The class is semantic and graded rather than a token list or a part-of-whole relation: held-out members fire (paragraph 1.99, stanza 1.71, column 1.22, page 3.01) while everyday concrete nouns in the identical grammatical slot (sandwich 0.00, blanket 0.02, pumpkin 0.00, door 0.00, peach, basket), generic part-whole words (roof 0.44, handle 0.01, middle 0.08, capital 0.00, part 0.19) and the same words in a non-structural sense ('Season the chicken' 0.04, 'we must act' 0.00, 'fishing line' 0.14, 'page at the hotel' 0.15) stay near the 0.03-0.16 baseline, and the containing whole is irrelevant ('line of the poem' and 'line of the menu' both peak 2.45).
